metricDefinitions.relevance: A module is relevant to a course when its ground-truth decision is match or partial. Courses with no match/partial label are excluded from Recall@K, HitRate@K and MRR denominators, matching the existing retrievalMetrics implementation.
metricDefinitions.recallAtK: Per-course recall over positive labels, macro-averaged across eligible courses.
metricDefinitions.hitRateAtK: Fraction of eligible courses with at least one relevant module in the top K.
metricDefinitions.mrr: MRR@K: reciprocal rank of the first relevant module within the top K; 0 when no relevant module is retrieved in the top K.
metricDefinitions.eligibleCourses: Courses with at least one match/partial label. Courses without a valid match contribute no Recall/HitRate/MRR denominator.
metricDefinitions.candidateReduction: Exhaustive matching compares every course with every module; retrieval returns the top K modules per course. Reduction is a candidate-count ratio, not a measured API-cost saving.
metricDefinitions.latency: Cold total = model load + first description run. Warm values are repeated steady-state runs in the same process. No GPU is used.

timing.protocol: Single process; model loaded once. The first description run starts immediately after load and is reported as cold. Remaining runs are warm steady-state measurements in the same process. Name and keyword runs follow the description runs, so their first run is already model-warm. Every strategy is repeated 5 times.
